plain: Touching or being next to something.

webster.text: Actual contact of bodies; a touching.

example.quote: This tendency has been considerably increased by the interference of foreign nations, the contiguity of their position to those nations rendering such interference easy.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
